transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in today?

I'm seeking help because I've been feeling extremely overwhelmed and distressed after a terrible event that happened five days ago. I keep having these awful, intrusive memories of it that just won't go away. It has been incredibly hard to cope since it happened.
Have you been experiencing these symptoms every day since the event, and do they include nightmares, feeling jumpy, or avoiding things that remind you of it?

Yes, I've been experiencing this every single day for the past five days since the event. I've been having awful, distressing nightmares about what happened almost every night. I wouldn't say I feel jumpy or that I'm avoiding reminders, but the nightmares and the constant distress are really overwhelming.

{
  "category": "differential point",
  "subcategory": "reexperiencing and arousal symptoms",
  "question": "Besides the nightmares, have you had any flashbacks, intense distress when reminded of the event, or difficulty sleeping or concentrating?"

Yes, I've had vivid flashbacks where it feels like the event is happening all over again, and I get intensely distressed whenever I'm reminded of it. I'm not really sure about having general trouble sleeping or concentrating, though.

{
  "category": "symptom presence",
  "subcategory": "dissociative symptoms",
  "question": "Have you felt numb, detached, or emotionally empty since the event, or felt like the world around you seems unreal?"
No, I haven't really experienced those feelings of being numb or detached. The world around me still feels real, it's just very overwhelming to deal with the memories.

{
  "category": "duration",
  "subcategory": "symptom persistence",
  "question": "How long have you been experiencing these flashbacks and nightmares—since the event five days ago, or did they start later?"
They started immediately after the event occurred five days ago. I have been experiencing them every single day and night since then.

{
  "category": "functional impact",
  "subcategory": "daily functioning",
  "question": "Have these symptoms made it difficult to carry out your usual daily activities, such as work, social interactions, or self-care?"

To be honest, I haven't really thought about how this is affecting my work or social life yet. Everything has been so overwhelming these past few days that I'm just not sure how much it has impacted those areas.

{
  "category": "functional impact",
  "subcategory": "daily functioning",
  "question": "Have you had trouble focusing, completing tasks, or getting out of bed because of these symptoms, even if just at home?"
I haven't really noticed any specific trouble with focusing or getting out of bed. I'm not sure if those have been issues for me, as I've mostly just been overwhelmed by the memories themselves.

In the past five days, have you had at least nine of the following symptoms: intrusive thoughts, nightmares, flashbacks, emotional distress when reminded, physical reactions to reminders, inability to remember key parts of the event, negative beliefs, negative mood, feeling detached, inability to experience positive emotions, irritability, reckless behavior, hypervigilance, exaggerated startle, concentration problems, or sleep disturbances?

No, I don't think I have nine of those, but I have definitely been experiencing several of them over the past five days. I have the intrusive thoughts, nightmares, flashbacks, intense emotional distress and physical reactions when I'm reminded of it, and I am also having trouble remembering specific parts of the event.
